decision_basis: Explicit product-owner instruction in the project conversation: the initial release will operate without a model.
included_surface: Static frontend and browser-local deterministic workflows that do not require inference
excluded_capabilities: any feature whose core acceptance depends on a model response
security_constraints: Do not add model API keys or model-provider secrets.
Do not silently route user content to an external inference provider.
Model-dependent controls must be unavailable or clearly marked unavailable in the initial release.
This profile is not model admission and does not approve any model, license, weights, or provider.
Any later model-backed release must switch to the strict model admission path with exact artifact/provider evidence and required approval.
future_model_release_requires: npm run test:model-license:release plus the full exact-SHA release and promotion gates.
